name: obytnote
description: ObytNote - A smart notebook and sticky notes app for creating, editing, and organizing notes.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public/src/assets/images', {recursive: true}); ['index.html','style.css','script.js','favicon.png','favicon.svg','logo.svg','favicon.jpg'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f); }); if (fs.existsSync('src/assets/images')) { fs.cpSync('src', 'public/src', {recursive: true}); } console.log('Build complete');"
